no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee meeting was held for this application. Although dupilumab is a new molecular entity and first-in class, the application itself did not present novel issues, not previously discussed, which merited advisory committee input.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the DUPIXENT (dupilumab) BLA761055 approval. The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Office Director memo all state that although dupilumab was a first-in-class new molecular entity, the application did not raise novel or controversial safety/efficacy issues meriting outside discussion. A prior DODAC meeting (9 March 2015) addressed pediatric development timing generally and only cited dupilumab as an example; it did not review this application, so there was no AdComm influence on the approval.
